- Emails: Send and inspect transactional email. Provide exactly one of html, tiptap, or markdown.
- Verify: Check syntax, typos, blocked domains, and mail routing for one address.
- Send Email: Queue one transactional email. Provide exactly one of html, tiptap, or markdown.
- Batch Emails: Send up to 100 transactional emails in one request.
- Get Email: Retrieve one sent or queued email by id.
- List Emails: List transactional API emails, newest first.
- Subscribers: List, create, update, tag, and unsubscribe contacts.
- List Subscribers: List contacts newest first. Paginate with cursor.
- Create Subscriber: Create or upsert a contact by email.
- Get Subscriber: Fetch one contact by id or email.
- Update Subscriber: Patch name, fields, or tags on a contact.
- Unsubscribe Subscriber: Mark a contact unsubscribed.
- Add Subscriber Tags: Attach tags to a contact.
- Remove Subscriber Tags: Detach tags from a contact.
- List Subscriber Events: List events recorded on one contact.
- Domains: Create and verify sending domains.
- List Domains: List sending domains for the organization.
- Create Domain: Register a sending domain and get DNS records.
- Get Domain: Fetch one sending domain by id or hostname.
- Verify Domain: Check DNS and mark the domain verified when records match.
- Campaigns: Draft, edit, schedule, and delete campaigns.
- List Campaigns: List campaigns newest first.
- Create Campaign: Create a draft campaign.
- Get Campaign: Fetch one campaign.
- Update Campaign: Patch a draft campaign.
- Delete Campaign: Delete a campaign.
- Send Campaign: Schedule or send a campaign immediately.
- Tags: List, create, and rename audience tags.
- List Tags: List audience tags.
- Create Tag: Create an audience tag.
- Get Tag: Fetch one tag by id or name.
- Update Tag: Rename an audience tag.
- Events: Record a payment or refund event on a subscriber.
- Tokens: List and mint organization lum_ tokens.
- List Tokens: List organization API tokens. Secrets are last-4 only.
- Create Token: Mint a lum_ token. The secret is returned once.
- Tools: Catalog and execute Lumail tools over REST.
- List Tools: Catalog of executable Lumail tools.
- Get Tool: Describe one tool and its input schema.
- Execute Tool: Run a Lumail tool by name.
- Send Email in HTML: Send transactional emails using raw HTML content
- Send Email in Markdown: Send transactional emails using Markdown content format
- Send Email in Tiptap: Send transactional emails using Tiptap JSON format (same as Lumail editor)
- List Subscribers: List subscribers in your Lumail account with optional filters
- Get Tag by ID or Name: Retrieve a specific tag with subscriber count from your Lumail account
- API Reference: Complete API documentation for Lumail.io integration
- Verify Email: Legacy `{ valid, error, code }` contract. Prefer POST /api/v2/verify.

## Integrations

- WordPress Plugin: Add a Lumail subscribe form to WordPress with [lumail_form]. The API token stays on the server.
- ClickFunnels Integration: Automatically sync contacts, tags, and order events from ClickFunnels to Lumail using webhooks
- SystemIO Integration: Automatically sync contacts and tags from SystemIO to Lumail using webhooks
- Integrations: Connect Lumail.io with your favorite platforms and tools

## Features

- Affiliate Program: Create your Lumail referral link and understand Creator, Pro, and Business rewards
- Account Verification: How sending gets unlocked automatically when you verify your domain, and how your sender score keeps it unlocked
- Language: Switch unsubscribe, confirmation, and survey pages to French, Spanish, or German. Email body, footer, and the Unsubscribe link are your copy — they are not auto-translated.
- Variables: Personalize your emails with dynamic variables and default values
- Tag Action Links: Let subscribers add or remove tags by clicking a link in your email
- Surveys: Ask a one-question survey inside an email and read the answers per campaign
- Content Deliverability Checker: A live 0–100 pre-flight in the editor. Fix spam traps before you hit send.
- Sender Health: How Lumail measures sending health, receiving-server delivery, and domain authentication
- Campaign Delivery Score: How the dashboard campaign delivery score is calculated, and how it differs from sender health
- Email Engagement Score: Learn how your email engagement score is calculated and how we track opens and clicks
- Bot vs Human Opens: How Lumail classifies opens and clicks as human, bot, or not evaluated, and where this appears in your metrics
- Subscriber Events: Complete reference for all subscriber event types in Lumail
- Revenue Tracking: Track purchases and revenue from your subscribers
- Email Sending Queue: How Lumail queues campaigns and workflow emails, and in which order they are sent
- Features: Discover advanced features and capabilities of Lumail.io

## Deliverability

- How to strengthen DMARC: Change p=none to quarantine or reject so spoofed mail is actually handled — including when the policy is inherited from your root domain.
- How to add DMARC: Publish a valid _dmarc TXT record so Lumail can verify DMARC on your sending domain.
- How to fix DKIM: Add the DKIM CNAME records from your Lumail domain page so mail is signed with a 2048-bit aligned key.
- How to verify a sending domain: Add the DNS records Lumail shows so the sending identity can be verified and used as From.
- How to fix MAIL FROM: Add the MX and SPF records on ses.your-domain.com so bounce handling and SPF alignment work.
- How to fix BIMI: Fix or remove a malformed BIMI TXT record. BIMI is optional and never required for a healthy sender.
- How to lower bounce rate: Clear invalid addresses when Lumail reports a sustained permanent bounce rate above 2% or 5%.
- How to lower complaint rate: Stop mailing people who hit “this is spam” when reported complaints stay elevated.
- How to fix delivery delays: What to do when receiving servers delay more than 10% of sent mail across consecutive windows.
- How to fix blocklist bounces: What Lumail means by blocked-list or spam concentration in bounce diagnostics — and what to do.
- How to fix sending infrastructure: What to do when bounce feedback, event tracking, or account sending is marked unhealthy in Lumail.
- How to fix a dedicated IP: What to do when the dedicated IP pool is missing, not ready, or warmup is stuck at 0%.
- How to fix a failed send: What to do when a campaign, workflow, test, or transactional send is rejected.
- How to fix a fallback-domain send: The primary sending domain failed and Lumail retried through a fallback domain. Fix the primary.
- How to fix an invalid email parameter: SES rejected from, to, subject, or headers. What to change before you retry.
- How to fix sending rate or daily quota: What to do when sends are throttled or the daily SES quota is exhausted.
- Recipient rate guards: Caps that stop the same mailbox from being hammered — 5 per 10 minutes, 20 per 24 hours, and bounce cooldowns.
- How to fix a monthly email limit: Upgrade or wait for reset when you hit 80%, 95%, or 100% of the monthly email allowance.
- How to fix a past-due payment pause: Sending and workflows stay parked until the outstanding invoice is paid.
- How to fix an admin sending pause: An administrator paused sending. You cannot resume this from DNS or billing.
- How to complete additional verification: Restore sending after a deliverability check, a declined request, or an info request.
- Campaign content verification rules: Why Lumail blocks cold email and phishing, and how to fix legitimate campaigns that need clearer branding or consent context.
- How to fix a failed campaign: The campaign finished processing but only some recipients were sent. How to find the hole and retry.
- How to fix a campaign render error: The campaign could not be prepared — invalid HTML or a render failure. What to edit before sending.
- Deliverability alerts: How-to guides for every Lumail deliverability alert — what it means and what to change.

## Workflows

- Workflow: Complete guide to Workflow graphs, versions, runs, groups, goals, exits, agent tools, publishing, and verification.
- Workflow Getting Started: Build, save, test, and publish your first graph-based workflow in Lumail.
- Workflow Triggers: Choose enrollment events, event filters, audience filters, and multiple entry points.
- Workflow Manual Enrollment: Filter subscribers, select all matches, and start a published workflow without waiting for a trigger.
- Workflow Branching: Route subscribers with conditions, event waits, A/B splits, move-to-step jumps, goals, and exits.
- Workflow A/B Testing: Build weighted variants, define one conversion signal, and compare success rates correctly.
- Workflow Goals: Define conversion goals, terminal goal steps, and event-driven success goals.
- Workflow Exit Rules: Stop active runs with global subscriber rules or explicit terminal exit steps.
- Workflow Publishing and Versions: Understand draft saves, immutable versions, activation, pausing, and safe updates.
- Workflow Test Runs and Results: Use dry runs, timelines, dashboards, and version-aware checks to verify workflow behavior.
- Test Workflow: Exercise campaigns, workflows, and transactional sends on fixture addresses without hitting real inboxes, bounces, or complaints.
- Wait Step: Configure duration, calendar, event, and audience waits in Workflow.
- Email Step: Configure owned Workflow emails, sending behavior, retries, personalization, and queue guarantees.
- Action Step: Manage tags, fields, enrollment, unsubscribe, and webhooks in Workflow.
- Webhook Step: Integrate external services with Workflow webhook actions.
- Workflow Groups: Configure mutual exclusion, conflict strategies, chaining, and Workflow group tools.
- Creating Workflows: Learn how to create and manage automated workflows for your subscribers

## Domains

- Email Domains: Configure your own domain for sending emails
- Web Domains: Serve capture pages on your own custom domain
- Tracking domains: Use your own domain for tracked links instead of Lumail's shared fallback
- Tracking domains: Shared: Understand Lumail's shared tracking domain, tracked URLs, and when to use your own domain
- Domains Overview: Configure email and web domains for your organization

- Privacy: Lumail privacy.
- Terms: Lumail terms.

# Lumail.io

> The AI-native email platform for newsletters, automations, and transactional email.

Prefer MCP, the CLI, or the TypeScript SDK for live organization operations. Fetch only the markdown pages you need; /llms-full.txt concatenates every page.

## Agents

- Migration to V2: Rewrite a v1 REST or SDK integration to API v2.
- Claude Code (Plugin): Install the Lumail plugin in Claude Code.
- Codex (Plugin): Connect the Codex CLI and app over OAuth.
- ChatGPT Plugin: Connect Lumail as a ChatGPT OAuth app.
- Cursor (MCP): Connect Cursor over MCP.
- Skills (CLI): Use the CLI and reusable agent skills.
- SDK Introduction: Use the typed TypeScript SDK.
- API Reference: Browse the REST API reference.
- OpenAPI 3.1 specification: Machine-readable Lumail integration endpoint.
- MCP server manifest: Machine-readable Lumail integration endpoint.
- MCP server: Machine-readable Lumail integration endpoint.
- MCP OAuth metadata: Machine-readable Lumail integration endpoint.
- Claude Code install: Machine-readable Lumail integration endpoint.
- Codex install: Machine-readable Lumail integration endpoint.
- CLI install: Machine-readable Lumail integration endpoint.

## Docs

- Documentation: How Lumail works. Campaigns, subscribers, deliverability, and workflows.
- SMTP: Connect SMTP-only tools to Lumail transactional email.
- Survey Block Formats: One-click polls inside an email — buttons, yes/no, emoji, and NPS, each stacked the same way the recipient sees them.

## Privacy & GDPR

- GDPR in Lumail: Current GDPR readiness, data locations, tracking, double opt-in, and steps for EU customers
- Data Processing Agreement (DPA): Review, accept and download your organization agreement with Codelynx, LLC
- Subprocessors: Current Lumail infrastructure providers, roles, locations, and change process
- Security and incident contact: How to report vulnerabilities and privacy incidents to Codelynx for Lumail
- Customer compliance guide: How to assess Lumail for GDPR, tracking, consent, export, and erasure

## Ship with Email

- Choose an Email MCP for Claude Code, Then Ship the Launch: Compare email MCPs by real launch work, connect Claude Code, and turn verified release evidence into a campaign your owned list can act on.
- Send a Newsletter from Cursor, Then Ship the Launch: Connect Cursor to your email stack, turn release evidence into a saved campaign, review the audience and render, and approve delivery deliberately.
- Move a Launch List from Kit Without Paying for Dormant Subscribers: Test a send-volume-priced Kit alternative with one real launch before moving your audience, automations, and suppression history.
- Ship with Email: Turn a product release, offer, or changelog into an owned-list launch while the rest of the product ships.

## Guides

- Guides: Practical Lumail playbooks for sending, migrating, and connecting tools.

## Tutorials

- Migration to high deliverability emails: Bring campaigns, OTP, and transactional mail up to current inbox hygiene — visible branding, a why-you-receive line, native double opt-in, and workflows that wait for confirmation.
- Clear Branding: Make every email instantly recognizable with a consistent company name, domain, or logo.
- Reason for Sending: Explain the specific action that caused someone to receive your email and name the brand they recognize.
- Enable Double Opt-In: Turn on native confirmation so new subscribers must click a link before they receive campaigns.
- Automatic list cleanup: Unsubscribe people who have not opened or clicked for 30, 90, or 180 days. Off by default. Preview before you enable.
- Create an API Token: Step-by-step guide to generating API tokens for authenticating your Lumail API requests.
- Send Transactional Email with SMTP: Configure your organization to send transactional email through Lumail from SMTP-only tools.
- Send React Email Templates with Lumail: Build transactional email templates as React components, render them to HTML, and send them through the Lumail transactional email API.
- Dynamic Promo Codes with Webhooks: Create unique, time-limited promo codes for each subscriber using workflow webhooks and custom fields.
- Tutorials: Step-by-step guides to build real-world email marketing automations with Lumail.

## AI Integration

- Prepare Your Lumail Account for Lumail 2.0.0: An operational guide for AI agents migrating marketing email to Lumail Workflows with clear branding and a reason for sending.
- Claude Code (Plugin): Install the Lumail plugin in Claude Code with OAuth—no API token to create, paste, or rotate.
- Codex (Plugin): Connect the Codex CLI and Codex app to Lumail over OAuth—no API token in config.toml.
- ChatGPT Plugin: Connect ChatGPT to Lumail with OAuth—no API token to copy or store.
- Hermes: Paste one prompt in Hermes Agent and it installs the Lumail CLI and skill, authenticates, and verifies the connection for you.
- Skills (CLI): Install Lumail as a Claude Code skill with the CLI for terminal-based AI workflows - manage subscribers, campaigns, and emails from natural language.
- OpenClaw: Install the Lumail skill and CLI via ClawHub for OpenClaw.
- Cursor (MCP): Add Lumail tools to Cursor IDE for AI-assisted email marketing directly from your editor.
- TypeScript SDK Integrations: Use the Lumail TypeScript SDK in web apps, backend services, scripts, and product automations.
- Tools API for AI Agents: Call any Lumail tool via a single REST endpoint - works with any language or AI framework.
- Tools reference: All 126 Lumail tools with their parameters, permissions and availability.
- Examples & Recipes: Real-world AI agent workflows and automation patterns using Lumail's API.
- AI Integration: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Hermes, or OpenClaw to Lumail, or use the SDK and Tools API for custom integrations.

- SDK 2.1.0: lumail@2.1.0 talks only to API v2 and returns { data, error }.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}

@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:23px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:26px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:13px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:150px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.chip .ic{width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- S2 ---------- */
#s2 .glow{position:absolute;left:560px;top:120px;width:800px;height:800px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,51,0,.55) 0%,rgba(255,51,0,.14) 45%,transparent 70%)}
#s2 .ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,90,46,.7)}
#logoBig{position:absolute;left:810px;top:320px;width:300px;height:300px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#s2 .word{position:absolute;left:846px;top:320px;height:300px;overflow:hidden;font:700 208px/300px Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:30px}
#s2 .word span{display:block;padding-top:0}
#s2 .intro{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;text-align:center;font-size:64px;color:#ff8462}
#s2 .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:700px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:68px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.14;color:#fff}
#s2 .tag .pill{color:var(--flare)}
#morph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--flare);z-index:95;visibility:hidden}

/* ---------- S3 ---------- */
#s3 .l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:186px;width:800px}
#s3 .hd{font-size:116px;margin-top:30px}
#s3 .sub{font-size:76px;color:var(--flare);margin-top:26px;line-height:1}
#s3 .apps-l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:800px;font:500 22px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
#s3 .apps{position:absolute;left:120px;top:840px;width:840px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.app{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:62px;padding:0 26px 0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.app i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#cfc8bf}
#s3 .card{position:absolute;left:960px;top:150px;width:840px;height:800px}
.b126{position:absolute;left:1500px;top:96px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;border-radius:30px;padding:16px 30px 20px;font:800 92px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;
  box-shadow:0 30px 50px -20px rgba(255,51,0,.6);display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.b126 span{font:600 32px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em;opacity:.95}

/* ---------- S4 ---------- */
#s4 .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}
#s4 .hd{position:absolute;left:120px;top:250px;font-size:106px}
#s4 .hd .serif{font-size:1.16em;color:var(--flare);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.win{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:34px;border:1.5px solid #f0d8cc;box-shadow:0 50px 90px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.4);overflow:hidden}
#ed{left:120px;top:410px;width:1000px;height:590px}
.ed-bar{height:76px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 26px;color:#3b3531;font:600 26px/1 Geist}
.ed-bar .tb{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ed-bar .tb .ic{width:26px;height:26px}
.ed-bar .sep{width:1.5px;height:30px;background:var(--line);margin:0 8px}
.ed-bar .ai{margin-left:auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:48px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--flare);font-size:24px}
.ed-bar .ai .ic{width:22px;height:22px}
.ed-body{padding:26px 46px}
.subj{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:32px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.subj em{font:500 20px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);font-style:normal;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.hey{margin-top:24px;font-size:38px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.var{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:54px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--flare);font:500 28px/1 "Geist Mono"}
.par{position:relative;margin-top:14px;font-size:30px;line-height:1.5;color:#3b3531;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.par .old,.par .new{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.par .pl{position:relative;white-space:nowrap}
.par .pl .hlbg{position:absolute;left:-6px;right:-6px;top:4px;bottom:4px;background:rgba(255,51,0,.16);border-radius:8px;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0)}
.par .pl .tx{position:relative}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:68px;padding:0 34px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;font:600 28px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em;box-shadow:0 20px 30px -16px rgba(255,51,0,.7)}
.btn .ic{width:26px;height:26px;stroke-width:2.4}
.ctab{margin-top:26px}
#pv{left:1240px;top:410px;width:560px;height:590px;background:#fff}
.pv-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:24px 28px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.pv-h svg{width:52px;height:52px}
.pv-h b{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.02em;display:block}
.pv-h small{font:400 20px/1.2 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted)}
.pv-h .now{margin-left:auto;font:500 20px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted)}
.pv-b{padding:26px 30px}
.pv-b .pv-s{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.15;min-height:40px}
.pv-b .pv-hey{margin-top:26px;font-size:25px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.pv-b .par{font-size:23px;margin-top:10px}
.pv-b .btn{height:54px;font-size:22px;padding:0 26px}
.tighter{position:absolute;left:1000px;top:660px;font-size:64px;color:var(--flare);transform:rotate(-7deg);white-space:nowrap;z-index:5;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.tighter svg{width:62px;height:62px;stroke-width:3}
.aicur{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;z-index:6;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0}
.aicur .ptr{width:34px;height:34px;fill:var(--flare);stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(120,30,0,.35))}
.aicur .lb{margin:26px 0 0 -6px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 18px 8px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 22px/1 Geist;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 12px 20px -10px rgba(255,51,0,.8)}
.aicur .lb .ic{width:20px;height:20px}

/* ---------- S5 ---------- */
#s5 .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}
#s5 .hd{position:absolute;left:120px;top:250px;font-size:112px;color:#fff}
#s5 .hd .serif{font-size:1.16em;color:#ff5a2e}
#s5 .pubcard{position:absolute;left:1400px;top:178px;width:400px;height:150px;border-radius:32px;background:#151311;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  padding:28px 34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
#s5 .pubcard small{font:500 20px/1 "Geist Mono";color:#a39a92;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
#s5 .pubcard .row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font:600 34px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:#fff}
.sw{position:relative;width:96px;height:52px;border-radius:999px;background:#3a3532}
.sw i{position:absolute;left:5px;top:5px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.node{position:absolute;width:260px;height:172px;border-radius:32px;background:#151311;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding:22px 24px;color:#fff}
.node .top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font:500 18px/1 "Geist Mono";letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a39a92}
.node .ico{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#ffb8a3;display:grid;place-items:center}
.node .ico .ic{width:24px;height:24px}
.node .main{margin-top:20px;font:600 30px/1.12 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.node .ok{position:absolute;right:-14px;top:-14px;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;border:4px solid #0b0b0a}
.node .ok .ic{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.4}
.node.out{width:290px;height:140px}
.node.out .main{margin-top:14px;font-size:30px}
#wires{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:visible}
.wire{fill:none;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.16);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round}
.lit{fill:none;stroke:#ff4a1c;stroke-width:4;stroke-linecap:round}
.pkt-core{fill:#fff}.pkt-halo{fill:rgba(255,51,0,.35)}

/* ---------- S6 ---------- */
#s6 .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}
#s6 .hd{position:absolute;left:120px;top:250px;font-size:132px}
#s6 .subp{position:absolute;left:120px;top:684px;width:700px;font:500 38px/1.3 Geist;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
#code{position:absolute;left:900px;top:150px;width:900px;height:500px;background:#14100e;border-radius:40px;box-shadow:0 60px 90px -40px rgba(80,10,0,.7);overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono";font-size:26px;line-height:1.62;color:#e9e3dc}
.code-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:22px 34px;border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#8f867e;font-size:22px}
.code-h i{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:#3a3532}
.code-h b{margin-left:14px;font-weight:500;color:#cfc7bf}
.code-b{padding:24px 38px}
.cl{white-space:pre;clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}
.k{color:#ff7a55}.s{color:#9be0b1}.p{color:#e9c9a8}.c{color:#8f867e}
.qd{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#9be0b1}
.qd .ic{width:26px;height:26px;stroke-width:3}
#lanes{position:absolute;left:900px;top:690px;width:900px;height:300px;background:#fff;border-radius:40px;box-shadow:0 60px 90px -40px rgba(80,10,0,.6);color:var(--ink);padding:30px 40px}
.lane{position:relative;height:108px}
.lane .lb{font:500 20px/1 "Geist Mono";letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.lane .tr{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:38px;height:56px;border-radius:18px;background:#f2efe9;overflow:hidden}
.lane .tr .sq{position:absolute;top:19px;width:26px;height:18px;border-radius:5px;background:#cbc4bb}
.otp{position:absolute;left:0;top:6px;height:44px;padding:0 18px 0 14px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  font:600 22px/1 "Geist Mono";box-shadow:0 10px 18px -8px rgba(255,51,0,.8);white-space:nowrap}
.otp .ic{width:22px;height:22px}
.trail{position:absolute;left:0;top:23px;height:10px;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,51,0,.6));width:0}
.dlv{position:absolute;right:10px;top:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font:600 22px/1 Geist;color:var(--green)}
.dlv .c{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center}
.dlv .c .ic{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.4}

/* ---------- S7a ---------- */
#s7a .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}
#s7a .hd{position:absolute;left:120px;top:250px;font-size:112px}
.slotw{display:inline-block;position:relative;height:1.06em;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;border-radius:.2em;background:#ffd9cc;padding:0 .2em;margin:.04em 0 0 -.2em;color:var(--accent)}
.slotw .col{display:block}
.slotw .col div{height:1.06em;line-height:1.06;white-space:nowrap}
#s7a .card{position:absolute;left:1000px;top:190px;width:800px;height:640px}
#s7a .stamp{position:absolute;left:120px;top:690px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;font:700 56px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
#s7a .stamp .ring{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center}
#s7a .stamp .ring .ic{width:44px;height:44px;stroke-width:3.2}
#s7a .stamp small{display:block;font:500 26px/1.2 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-top:6px}
.marq{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:915px;height:96px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 10%,#000 90%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 10%,#000 90%,transparent)}
.marq .in{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:70px;white-space:nowrap;font:600 44px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:#9b928a}
.marq .in span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:70px}
.marq .in span::after{content:"";width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#d9cfc6}
.marq-l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:884px;font:500 21px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}

/* ---------- S7b ---------- */
#s7b .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}
#s7b .hd{position:absolute;left:120px;top:250px;font-size:122px;color:#fff}
#s7b .hd .fl{color:#ff5a2e}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:23px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:26px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:13px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:150px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.chip .ic{width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- S2 ---------- */
#s2 .glow{position:absolute;left:560px;top:120px;width:800px;height:800px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,51,0,.55) 0%,rgba(255,51,0,.14) 45%,transparent 70%)}
#s2 .ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,90,46,.7)}
#logoBig{position:absolute;left:810px;top:320px;width:300px;height:300px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#s2 .word{position:absolute;left:846px;top:320px;height:300px;overflow:hidden;font:700 208px/300px Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:30px}
#s2 .word span{display:block;padding-top:0}
#s2 .intro{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;text-align:center;font-size:64px;color:#ff8462}
#s2 .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:700px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:68px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.14;color:#fff}
#s2 .tag .pill{color:var(--flare)}
#morph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--flare);z-index:95;visibility:hidden}

/* ---------- S3 ---------- */
#s3 .l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:186px;width:800px}
#s3 .hd{font-size:116px;margin-top:30px}

<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}

.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;

/* brand bug */

.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */

      <div class="tl" id="m4"><span class="mk"><i class="dot"></i></span><span class="ta">Done. Ready in <b>8 minutes</b>.</span></div>
    </div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="stamp" id="stamp"><span class="ring"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span><span>Ready in 8 min<small>contacts · tags · workflows</small></span></div>
  <div class="marq-l">Migrate from</div>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:23px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:26px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:13px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:150px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:23px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:26px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:13px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:150px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.chip .ic{width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- S2 ---------- */
#s2 .glow{position:absolute;left:560px;top:120px;width:800px;height:800px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,51,0,.55) 0%,rgba(255,51,0,.14) 45%,transparent 70%)}

#logoBig{position:absolute;left:810px;top:320px;width:300px;height:300px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#s2 .word{position:absolute;left:846px;top:320px;height:300px;overflow:hidden;font:700 208px/300px Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:30px}
#s2 .word span{display:block;padding-top:0}
#s2 .intro{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;text-align:center;font-size:64px;color:#ff8462}
#s2 .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:700px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:68px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.14;color:#fff}
#s2 .tag .pill{color:var(--flare)}
#morph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--flare);z-index:95;visibility:hidden}

/* ---------- S3 ---------- */
#s3 .l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:186px;width:800px}
#s3 .hd{font-size:116px;margin-top:30px}
#s3 .sub{font-size:76px;color:var(--flare);margin-top:26px;line-height:1}

#s3 .apps{position:absolute;left:120px;top:840px;width:840px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.app{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:62px;padding:0 26px 0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.app i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#cfc8bf}
#s3 .card{position:absolute;left:960px;top:150px;width:840px;height:800px}
.b126{position:absolute;left:1500px;top:96px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;border-radius:30px;padding:16px 30px 20px;font:800 92px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;
  box-shadow:0 30px 50px -20px rgba(255,51,0,.6);display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.b126 span{font:600 32px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em;opacity:.95}

/* ---------- S4 ---------- */
#s4 .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}

#s4 .hd .serif{font-size:1.16em;color:var(--flare);letter-spacing:-.01em}

.ctab{margin-top:26px}

      <div class="tl" id="s3l4"><span class="mk"><i class="dot"></i></span><span class="ta"><span class="ty"></span><span class="caret"></span></span></div>

  </div></div>

</div></section>

<!-- ========== S4 : EDITOR ========== -->

    <div class="pv-h"><svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"><use href="#tile"/></svg><div><b>Lumail</b><small>hello@yourdomain.com</small></div><span class="now">now</span></div>

    <div class="code-b">

      <div class="cl" id="c2">  to: <span class="s">"ada@acme.dev"</span>,</div>

      <div class="cl" id="c4">  subject: <span class="s">"Your login code"</span>,</div>

    <div class="lane" style="margin-top:6px"><div class="lb"><span>Priority lane</span><span>Login codes</span></div>
      <div class="tr" id="tr2" style="overflow:visible;background:#fff1ec"><div class="trail" id="trail"></div><div class="otp" id="otp"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-zap"/></svg>481 902</div>
        <div class="dlv" id="dlv"><span class="c"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span>0.4s</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div></section>

<!-- ========== S7a : MIGRATION ========== -->
<section class="scene paper" id="s7a"><div class="pan">
  <div class="kick"><div class="kicker"><i></i>Migration</div></div>
  <h2 class="hd">
    <div class="ln"><span class="wm"><span class="wi">Migrate from</span></span></div>
    <div class="ln"><span class="slotw" id="slot"><span class="col" id="slotCol"></span></span></div>
    <div class="ln"><span class="wm"><span class="wi">in under 10 min.</span></span></div>
  </h2>
  <div class="peach card" id="s7card"><div class="term">
    <div class="term-h"><b>codex</b><span class="live"><i></i>lumail · 126 tools</span></div>
    <div class="term-b">
      <div class="tl" id="m0"><span class="mk gt">></span><span class="ta"><span class="ty"></span><span class="caret"></span></span></div>
      <div class="tl" id="m1"><span class="mk"><i class="dot"></i></span><span class="ta">lumail - import_subscribers <span class="mut">(MCP)</span></span></div>
      <div class="tl" id="m1r"><span class="mk"><i class="elbow"></i></span><span class="ta"><span class="hl cnt">0</span> contacts</span></div>
      <div class="tl" id="m2"><span class="mk"><i class="dot"></i></span><span class="ta">lumail - import_tags <span class="mut">(MCP)</span></span></div>
      <div class="tl" id="m2r"><span class="mk"><i class="elbow"></i></span><span class="ta"><span class="hl cnt">0</span> tags</span></div>
      <div class="tl" id="m3"><span class="mk"><i class="dot"></i></span><span class="ta">lumail - import_sequences <span class="mut">(MCP)</span></span></div>
      <div class="tl" id="m3r"><span class="mk"><i class="elbow"></i></span><span class="ta"><span class="hl cnt">0</span> workflows</span></div>
      <div class="tl" id="m4"><span class="mk"><i class="dot"></i></span><span class="ta">Done. Ready in <b>8 minutes</b>.</span></div>
    </div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="stamp" id="stamp"><span class="ring"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></span><span>Ready in 8 min<small>contacts · tags · workflows</small></span></div>
  <div class="marq-l">Migrate from</div>

</div></section>

<!-- ========== S7b : PRICING ========== -->

  <div class="plan free" id="pFree"><div class="nm">Free</div><div class="pr"><sup>$</sup>0</div><div class="per">/month</div>
    <ul><li><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-check"/></svg>3,000 emails / month</li><li><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-check"/></svg>No card required</li><li><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-check"/></svg>Agent, API, CLI & SDK</li></ul>
    <div class="foot">Unlimited subscribers</div></div>
  <div class="plan crt" id="pCrt"><div class="nm">Creator<span class="badge">Most picked</span></div><div class="pr"><sup>$</sup>20</div><div class="per">/month</div>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:23px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
