<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:24px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:34px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:19px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:168px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.chip .ic{width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- S2 ---------- */
#s2 .glow{position:absolute;left:560px;top:120px;width:800px;height:800px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,51,0,.55) 0%,rgba(255,51,0,.14) 45%,transparent 70%)}
#s2 .ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,90,46,.7)}
#logoBig{position:absolute;left:810px;top:320px;width:300px;height:300px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#s2 .word{position:absolute;left:846px;top:320px;height:300px;overflow:hidden;font:700 208px/300px Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:30px}
#s2 .word span{display:block;padding-top:0}
#s2 .intro{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;text-align:center;font-size:64px;color:#ff8462}
#s2 .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:700px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:68px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.14;color:#fff}
#s2 .tag .pill{color:var(--flare)}
#morph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--flare);z-index:95;visibility:hidden}

/* ---------- S3 ---------- */
#s3 .l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:186px;width:800px}
#s3 .hd{font-size:116px;margin-top:30px}
#s3 .sub{font-size:76px;color:var(--flare);margin-top:26px;line-height:1}
#s3 .apps-l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:800px;font:500 22px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
#s3 .apps{position:absolute;left:120px;top:840px;width:840px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.app{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:62px;padding:0 26px 0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.app i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#cfc8bf}
#s3 .card{position:absolute;left:960px;top:160px;width:840px;height:770px}
.b126{position:absolute;left:1440px;top:104px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;border-radius:30px;padding:16px 30px 20px;font:800 92px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;
  box-shadow:0 30px 50px -20px rgba(255,51,0,.6);display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.b126 span{font:600 32px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em;opacity:.95}

/* ---------- S4 ---------- */
#s4 .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}
#s4 .hd{position:absolute;left:120px;top:250px;font-size:106px}
#s4 .hd .serif{font-size:1.16em;color:var(--flare);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.win{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:34px;border:1.5px solid #f0d8cc;box-shadow:0 50px 90px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.4);overflow:hidden}
#ed{left:120px;top:410px;width:920px;height:590px}
.ed-bar{height:76px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 26px;color:#3b3531;font:600 26px/1 Geist}
.ed-bar .tb{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ed-bar .tb .ic{width:26px;height:26px}
.ed-bar .sep{width:1.5px;height:30px;background:var(--line);margin:0 8px}
.ed-bar .ai{margin-left:auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:48px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--flare);font-size:24px}
.ed-bar .ai .ic{width:22px;height:22px}
.ed-body{padding:26px 46px}
.subj{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:32px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.subj em{font:500 20px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);font-style:normal;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.hey{margin-top:24px;font-size:38px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.var{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:54px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--flare);font:500 28px/1 "Geist Mono"}
.par{position:relative;margin-top:14px;font-size:30px;line-height:1.5;color:#3b3531;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.par .old,.par .new{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.par .pl{position:relative;white-space:nowrap;min-height:1.5em}
.par .pl .hlbg{position:absolute;left:-6px;right:-6px;top:4px;bottom:4px;background:rgba(255,51,0,.16);border-radius:8px;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0)}
.par .pl .tx{position:relative}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:68px;padding:0 34px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;font:600 28px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em;box-shadow:0 20px 30px -16px rgba(255,51,0,.7)}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:24px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:34px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:19px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:168px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.chip .ic{width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- S2 ---------- */
#s2 .glow{position:absolute;left:560px;top:120px;width:800px;height:800px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,51,0,.55) 0%,rgba(255,51,0,.14) 45%,transparent 70%)}
#s2 .ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,90,46,.7)}
#logoBig{position:absolute;left:810px;top:320px;width:300px;height:300px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#s2 .word{position:absolute;left:846px;top:320px;height:300px;overflow:hidden;font:700 208px/300px Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:30px}
#s2 .word span{display:block;padding-top:0}
#s2 .intro{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;text-align:center;font-size:64px;color:#ff8462}
#s2 .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:700px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:68px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.14;color:#fff}
#s2 .tag .pill{color:var(--flare)}
#morph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--flare);z-index:95;visibility:hidden}

/* ---------- S3 ---------- */
#s3 .l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:186px;width:800px}
#s3 .hd{font-size:116px;margin-top:30px}
#s3 .sub{font-size:76px;color:var(--flare);margin-top:26px;line-height:1}
#s3 .apps-l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:800px;font:500 22px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
#s3 .apps{position:absolute;left:120px;top:840px;width:840px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.app{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:62px;padding:0 26px 0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.app i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#cfc8bf}
#s3 .card{position:absolute;left:960px;top:160px;width:840px;height:770px}
.b126{position:absolute;left:1440px;top:104px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;border-radius:30px;padding:16px 30px 20px;font:800 92px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;
  box-shadow:0 30px 50px -20px rgba(255,51,0,.6);display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.b126 span{font:600 32px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em;opacity:.95}

/* ---------- S4 ---------- */
#s4 .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}
#s4 .hd{position:absolute;left:120px;top:250px;font-size:106px}
#s4 .hd .serif{font-size:1.16em;color:var(--flare);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.win{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:34px;border:1.5px solid #f0d8cc;box-shadow:0 50px 90px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.4);overflow:hidden}
#ed{left:120px;top:410px;width:920px;height:570px}
.why{margin-top:22px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);font:400 20px/1.35 "Geist Mono";color:#8a827b;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.ed-bar{height:76px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 26px;color:#3b3531;font:600 26px/1 Geist}
.ed-bar .tb{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ed-bar .tb .ic{width:26px;height:26px}
.ed-bar .sep{width:1.5px;height:30px;background:var(--line);margin:0 8px}

<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>

@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:24px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:34px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:19px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}

.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:24px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:34px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:19px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:168px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.chip .ic{width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- S2 ---------- */
#s2 .glow{position:absolute;left:560px;top:120px;width:800px;height:800px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,51,0,.55) 0%,rgba(255,51,0,.14) 45%,transparent 70%)}

#logoBig{position:absolute;left:810px;top:320px;width:300px;height:300px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#s2 .word{position:absolute;left:846px;top:320px;height:300px;overflow:hidden;font:700 208px/300px Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:30px}
#s2 .word span{display:block;padding-top:0}
#s2 .intro{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;text-align:center;font-size:64px;color:#ff8462}
#s2 .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:700px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:68px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.14;color:#fff}

:root{

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:24px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}

<html lang="en">

<style>

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">

<style>

:root{

  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */

.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}

.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:24px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:34px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:19px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:168px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.chip .ic{width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- S2 ---------- */
#s2 .glow{position:absolute;left:560px;top:120px;width:800px;height:800px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,51,0,.55) 0%,rgba(255,51,0,.14) 45%,transparent 70%)}
#s2 .ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,90,46,.7)}
#logoBig{position:absolute;left:810px;top:320px;width:300px;height:300px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#s2 .word{position:absolute;left:846px;top:320px;height:300px;overflow:hidden;font:700 208px/300px Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:30px}
#s2 .word span{display:block;padding-top:0}
#s2 .intro{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;text-align:center;font-size:64px;color:#ff8462}
#s2 .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:700px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:68px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.14;color:#fff}
#s2 .tag .pill{color:var(--flare)}
#morph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--flare);z-index:95;visibility:hidden}

/* ---------- S3 ---------- */
#s3 .l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:186px;width:800px}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:24px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:34px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:19px}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;
  padding:.01em .3em .07em .22em;border:.02em solid rgba(26,22,20,.07);box-shadow:0 .05em 0 rgba(26,22,20,.05),0 .32em .55em -.22em rgba(255,51,0,.38)}
.pill .ic{width:.58em;height:.58em;stroke-width:2.2}
.kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:58px;padding:0 28px 0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffe2d8;color:#8a2306;
  font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kicker i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.kicker.dk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#ffbba6}.kicker.dk i{background:#ff633d}
.kicker.wh{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff}.kicker.wh i{background:#fff}

/* brand bug */
.bug{position:absolute;left:120px;top:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;z-index:100;color:var(--ink)}
.bug svg{width:54px;height:54px;display:block}
.bug .tiles{position:relative;width:54px;height:54px}
.bug .tiles svg{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bug-word{font:700 38px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.bug-url{position:absolute;right:120px;top:76px;z-index:100;font:500 26px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* cards */
.peach{background:var(--peach);border-radius:56px;padding:26px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(196,50,10,.06)}
.term{background:#fff;border-radius:32px;border:1.5px solid #f1ddd3;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(140,45,10,.32);height:100%;overflow:hidden;
  font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace;font-size:24px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:21px;color:var(--muted)}
.term-h b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.term-h .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.term-h .live i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.term-b{padding:34px 30px 0}
.tl{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:19px}
.mk{flex:0 0 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-top:.62em}
.dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green)}
.elbow{width:12px;height:12px;border-left:2px solid #8a827b;border-bottom:2px solid #8a827b;margin-left:8px;margin-top:-.15em}
.gt{color:var(--flare);font-weight:600;padding-top:0;font-size:1em}
.mut{color:#8a827b}
.hl{background:#ffe2d8;color:#b32900;padding:0 .32em;border-radius:.3em;font-weight:600}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:.6em;height:1.15em;background:var(--flare);vertical-align:-.2em;margin-left:2px}
.ta{flex:1}

/* ---------- S1 ---------- */
#s1 .copy{position:absolute;left:120px;top:0;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-top:8px}
#s1 .hd{font-size:168px}
.strk{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.strk .sk-line{position:absolute;left:-.04em;right:-.04em;top:56%;height:.1em;background:var(--flare);border-radius:.05em;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0) rotate(-1.4deg)}
.chip{position:absolute;display:block}
.chip .bob{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:88px;padding:0 34px 0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 24px 40px -24px rgba(26,22,20,.35);font:600 40px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.chip .ic{width:38px;height:38px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- S2 ---------- */
#s2 .glow{position:absolute;left:560px;top:120px;width:800px;height:800px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,51,0,.55) 0%,rgba(255,51,0,.14) 45%,transparent 70%)}
#s2 .ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,90,46,.7)}
#logoBig{position:absolute;left:810px;top:320px;width:300px;height:300px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#s2 .word{position:absolute;left:846px;top:320px;height:300px;overflow:hidden;font:700 208px/300px Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:30px}
#s2 .word span{display:block;padding-top:0}
#s2 .intro{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:150px;text-align:center;font-size:64px;color:#ff8462}
#s2 .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:700px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;font-size:68px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.14;color:#fff}
#s2 .tag .pill{color:var(--flare)}
#morph{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--flare);z-index:95;visibility:hidden}

/* ---------- S3 ---------- */
#s3 .l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:186px;width:800px}
#s3 .hd{font-size:116px;margin-top:30px}
#s3 .sub{font-size:76px;color:var(--flare);margin-top:26px;line-height:1}
#s3 .apps-l{position:absolute;left:120px;top:800px;font:500 22px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
#s3 .apps{position:absolute;left:120px;top:840px;width:840px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.app{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:62px;padding:0 26px 0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font:600 27px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.app i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#cfc8bf}
#s3 .card{position:absolute;left:960px;top:160px;width:840px;height:770px}
.b126{position:absolute;left:1440px;top:104px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;border-radius:30px;padding:16px 30px 20px;font:800 92px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.05em;
  box-shadow:0 30px 50px -20px rgba(255,51,0,.6);display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.b126 span{font:600 32px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em;opacity:.95}

/* ---------- S4 ---------- */
#s4 .kick{position:absolute;left:120px;top:168px}
#s4 .hd{position:absolute;left:120px;top:250px;font-size:106px}
#s4 .hd .serif{font-size:1.16em;color:var(--flare);letter-spacing:-.01em}

#ed{left:120px;top:410px;width:920px;height:590px}
.why{margin-top:22px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);font:400 20px/1.35 "Geist Mono";color:#8a827b;letter-spacing:-.01em}
