.ed-bar .ai{margin-left:auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:48px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--flare);font-size:24px}
.ed-bar .ai .ic{width:22px;height:22px}
.ed-body{padding:26px 46px}
.subj{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:32px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.subj em{font:500 20px/1 "Geist Mono";color:var(--muted);font-style:normal;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.hey{margin-top:24px;font-size:38px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.var{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:54px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--tint);color:var(--flare);font:500 28px/1 "Geist Mono"}
.par{position:relative;margin-top:14px;font-size:30px;line-height:1.5;color:#3b3531;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.par .old,.par .new{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}

.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:68px;padding:0 34px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--flare);color:#fff;font:600 28px/1 Geist;letter-spacing:-.02em;box-shadow:0 20px 30px -16px rgba(255,51,0,.7)}

.ctab{margin-top:26px}
#pv{left:1240px;top:410px;width:560px;height:570px;background:#fff}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Lumail launch</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:700;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-700-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Geist;font-weight:800;src:url(fonts/geist-latin-800-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:500;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/geist-mono-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Instrument Serif";font-style:italic;font-weight:400;src:url(fonts/instrument-serif-latin-400-italic.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:Caveat;font-weight:600;src:url(fonts/caveat-latin-600-normal.woff2) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --flare:#ff3300; --flare2:#ed4541; --accent:#c4320a; --ink:#1a1614; --void:#08090a;
  --paper:#f8f7f4; --muted:#5f5853; --line:#e6e1da; --tint:#fff1ec; --peach:#fdebe2; --green:#2fa866;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#000}
#stage{position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);
  font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:geometricPrecision}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono",monospace}
.serif{font-family:"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.005em}
.hand{font-family:Caveat,cursive;font-weight:600}

/* scenes */
.scene{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;z-index:10}
.pan{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.paper{background:var(--paper)}
.paper::before,.peachbg::before,.void::before,.flare::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.paper::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,22,20,.16) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.peachbg{background:#fbe6db}
.peachbg::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(196,50,10,.18) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 30%,transparent 100%)}
.void{background:#0b0b0a;color:#f7f8f8}
.void::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 75% at 50% 45%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}
.flare{background:radial-gradient(1400px 900px at 15% 0%,#ff5a2e 0%,#ff3300 55%,#e82d00 100%);color:#fff}
.flare::before{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px);background-size:40px 40px;background-position:20px 20px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 50%,#000 20%,transparent 100%)}

/* type */
.hd{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.03}
.ln{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.wm{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding:.09em .06em .2em;margin:-.09em -.06em -.2em}
.wi{display:inline-block;will-change:transform}
.fl{color:var(--flare)}
.ic{width:1em;height:1em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;overflow:visible}

/* bubbles & tags (site DA) */
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.2em;vertical-align:-.06em;background:#fff;color:var(--flare);border-radius:.44em;

content.text:
`video.mp4` and `index.html` are both in the workspace root. The video is 45 s at 1920×1080 (16:9), and it plays and ends correctly in the player, tested in headless Chrome.

**The video**
- **Look:** It uses Lumail's own identity (paper/flare/ink/void colours, Geist, Instrument Serif italic, the tile logo) and I built it in HTML/GSAP.
- **Audio:** The 128 BPM soundtrack and sound effects are synthesized in code, with the beats and cuts locked to the music.
- **Storyline:**
  1. Hook: "Email shouldn't feel like a second job."
  2. Logo reveal.
  3. AI agent sending campaigns, with the "126 MCP tools" badge.
  4. The visual editor's live AI rewrite.
  5. Workflow builder.
  6. Transactional email.
  7. Mailchimp migration.
  8. Usage-based pricing.
  9. 3M+ emails proof with a quote.
  10. End card: "Start free →".
- **Encoding:** It is H.264 High yuv420p (BT.709) with AAC 48 kHz stereo, 1350 frames at 30 fps, 21.9 MB.
- **Audio levels:** Loudness is about −15 LUFS, and the true peak is −1.8 dBTP.

**The player**
- **Title:** The tab title is "Claude Sonnet 5.5". There is no visible heading, and it's a single `<video controls>`.
- **Fit:** The video box is always exactly 16:9, fully inside the viewport, and touches the width or height. I checked 1920×1080, 1280×720, 1000×1000, 1600×500, 500×900, 2560×1080 and 390×844, with no cropping, distortion or scrollbars.
- **Playback:** It advances normally and reaches `ended` at 45 s with no media errors. The only console noise was `net::ERR_ABORTED` on the `video.mp4` range requests, which Chrome does on `file://`.

**Fixed along the way**
- The soundtrack's true peak was +0.9 dBFS, which would have clipped after AAC encoding. The cause was `alimiter` auto-levelling. I fixed it with a 192 kHz limiter with auto-level off, and patched `src/audio.mjs` to match.
- I tightened the terminal card spacing in `src/scene.html` so the last line doesn't sit against the card's bottom edge.

`src/` holds the scene, timeline, audio and render scripts, so it's reproducible with `pnpm`. I deleted the scratch and temp files.Both background tasks finished successfully, and I've already handled their results:

- **Audio regeneration:** The soundtrack rebuilt cleanly at 45.0 s. It had a true-peak problem (+0.9 dBFS), which I fixed with a true-peak-aware limiter and installed as `src/audio.wav`.
- **Full render and encode:** `video.mp4` came out at 45.000 s, 1920×1080, 1350 frames, with the fixed audio.

`index.html` is written and checked in the browser, and the scratch files are removed. Nothing further is needed.
